Assets in the path total about 543.61 MiB, including voice/video, audio-library and reference-image resources; none are stripped. The selected path is below 2000 files but exceeds the Market 1 MiB/file and 50 MiB total budgets; budgetExemptPaths cannot raise the total. The root MIT LICENSE is outside the path and staging does not attach it, so the installed copy lacks that notice; this does not mean Market cannot reference the MIT upstream. Original structure/resources/install method are preserved, without slimming or custom fetch.
